verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Lovable API", served from the API host at api.lovable.dev/v1/openapi.yaml, and its API reference pages render from that same spec. The probe's 404s were on docs.lovable.dev paths, not the API host, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the api.lovable.dev spec URL is downloadable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Lovable serves its full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Lovable API") from the API host itself
The docs reference pages render from the same spec.
